name: Malachi
background: A licensed merchant operating under Sanhedrin authorization. He specializes in high-margin currency exchange for pilgrims requiring Tyrian shekels.

genericReactions.physical: Is this going to pay for my overturned table? I think not.
genericReactions.testimonial: He called us robbers! We are licensed by the Temple!
genericReactions.digital: Our exchange rates are approved by the priests. It's all legal.
genericReactions.environmental: He made a mess of the entire courtyard. It's a disgrace.
genericReactions.analytical: I can tell you the exact amount of silver he scattered in the dirt. An outrage!
genericReactions.prophecy: A prophet? He's a menace to commerce and order.
